verdict.rationale: Yubico documents a broad set of official SDKs: the .NET YubiKey SDK, YubiKit for Android (USB/NFC, plus a high-level FIDO2/WebAuthn client) and iOS, java-webauthn-server for relying parties, and python-fido2. A runtime probe confirmed python-fido2 (fido2 2.2.1) and yubikey-manager resolve on public PyPI, so the SDKs are live and installable. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs, and per-SDK depth beyond brief first-party descriptions.
